theory.heading: What Python Full-Stack Capstone is
theory.body: Python Full-Stack Capstone describes the methods and patterns used within Python Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Python Full-Stack Capstone matters
theory.body: Without Python Full-Stack Capstone, systems built with Python Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Python Full-Stack Capstone works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Python Full-Stack Capstone follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Python Full-Stack Capstone
theory.body: Python Full-Stack Capstone offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
